articles.title: Pictures of Phil Tippett’s Movie Work Appear Online
articles.summary: An unnamed fan shared pictures and videos of Phil Tippett’s movie work, including Star Wars creatures and material from other films.

articles.title: Nikola Bartunkova beats Aryna Sabalenka at China Open
articles.summary: Nikola Bartunkova surprised world number two Aryna Sabalenka with a 6-4, 6-3 win at the China Open. She will play Sinja Kraus next.

articles.title: Viewers Say AI Used an Existing Bot in StarCraft Contest
articles.summary: Viewers said GPT-6 Astra used an existing bot in a StarCraft contest. The creator said he was restoring its earlier code so it could keep playing.
